name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €86/MWh, down about 15% on the week but above the €70 Alert line
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €85.6/MWh on 6 Nov, heading for a weekly fall of about 15% on hopes of a Middle East settlement, but above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance; Trading Economics). EU storage was about 74% full against a five-year norm of about 90%, and attacks near Hormuz, the route for Qatari LNG, continued on 5–6 Nov (Trading Economics).
for_you: Households and firms on variable tariffs remain exposed to high wholesale gas costs this winter. Ofgem's price cap passes changes through with a delay.
why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
